final_draft.answer: The default branch (main) of our application repository, harborlight/app on GitHub, is protected. A change needs 1 approving review before it can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well. This was observed on 2026-11-18.
final_draft.note: Please check before sending: the approved answer and the live setting disagree. The approved answer (answer:9129d762-03d2-47ea-a17d-657350a659d7, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) says changes need two approving reviews. A live check of harborlight/app on 2026-11-18T03:40:20Z found only 1 approving review required. The answer gives the observed setting, not the approved wording. Either the branch protection should go back to 2 reviews, or the approved answer should be changed to say 1. The answer owner should decide which, and then the answer can be updated.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:9129d762-03d2-47ea-a17d-657350a65: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:3c3f2f1a-1091-40f7-99d0-213d2378a: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:593fec38-a684-4892-ac88-1981adbd6: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:e609a578-3cfb-413a-aeac-2618c87a3: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:df39feac-307b-4c9c-a71c-4bbbfda56: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
